bow.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: runtime bow projection atlas, preserving approved fantasy item quality family. Image1 HeroCBowSides is authoritative for a PHYSICALLY CORRECT unpulled recurve bow side projection; image2 HeroCBows gives BACK and FRONT foreshortened camera projections only (ignore its incorrectly triangular pulled strings). Image3 is the approved quality MATERIAL/ornament/color lineage only; do NOT reuse its diagonal UI orientation or irregular bent handle.
Make a single FULLY TRANSPARENT RGBA 2048x1536 atlas with EXACTLY8equal columns by3equal rows (256x512 cells). Columns are qualities F,E,D,C,B,A,S,SSS with NO text labels. Top row: RIGHT side view, bow vertical, smoothly symmetric limbs curving right, straight single vertical string on LEFT, central grip midway in height. Middle row: BACK view, narrow slightly oblique/edge-on vertical view like source second narrow bow; keep central grip midpoint, readable width, no duplicate strings. Bottom row: FRONT view, bow horizontally foreshortened as source last short horizontal bow, curved wooden limbs BELOW the one straight horizontal string, central grip below midpoint at consistent position. All objects centered entirely inside their own equal cell with at least12% transparent gutter. Same size, scale, angle and grip position across all8qualities in each row. Exactly24 bows.
Each bow must be an anatomically sensible recurve bow: two smooth balanced limbs with central wrapped riser/grip, ONE straight taut string running directly between the two tips. No string attached to grip, triangle or V/string pull, no arrow, no hand/character, no crooked/chunky broken handle, no asymmetrical limbs. Family material evolution Frough brown wood(simple bow, NOT an ugly crooked branch), Eiron fittings, Dsteel, Ccool silver/blue accents, Bplum inlays, Ascarlet, Sgold trim, SSSpale gold/ivory fine ornament. Keep limb geometry graceful and functional; progressive refinement not absurd bulky shapes. Painted volumetric original game art, crisp readable silhouette at small world size, same approved style. No bloom/glow/clouds/FX behind it. Transparent pixels between ALL cells, no background/gradient/text/frames/watermark. These replace only malformed bow presentation, not hero armor or any gameplay mechanic.
